data.name: Simon
data.gender_notes: Simon is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Shimʿon, from the root sh-m-ʿ, 'to hear' — 'he has heard'. Its root is Hebrew sh-m-ʿ. Simon Peter; Simon the Zealot. Simon is a Hebrew name meaning “He has heard”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Simon expresses “He has heard”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Shimʿon, from the root sh-m-ʿ, 'to hear' — 'he has heard'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Simon total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
